description_en: Queries the information about a DataWorks workspace
description_zh: 该接口用于查询一个DataWorks工作空间的详细信息
name: GetProject

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html接口获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html operation to query the name
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的名称。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html接口获取工作空间的名称
parameters.name: project_identifier

DefaultDiResourceGroupIdentifier.description_en: The ID of the resource group that was allocated by default when you purchased an exclusive resource group for MaxCompute
DefaultDiResourceGroupIdentifier.description_zh: 购买MaxCompute独享资源组时，默认分配的资源组的标识

DisableDevelopment.description_en:
Indicates whether the Develop role is disabled. Valid values:

false (default)
true
DisableDevelopment.description_zh:
是否禁用开发角色，取值如下：
false：默认值，开启开发角色。
true：禁用开发角色

EnvTypes.description_en: The environment information of the workspace
EnvTypes.description_zh: 工作空间包含的环境信息

items.description_en:
The environment of the workspace. Valid values: PROD and DEV.

The value PROD indicates the production environment. Workspaces in basic mode provide only the production environment.
The value DEV indicates the development environment. Workspaces in standard mode provide both the development environment and the production environment
items.description_zh:
工作空间包含的环境：
简单模式只有生产环境（PROD）。
标准模式包含开发环境（DEV）和生产环境（PROD）

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the workspace was created. Example: `Dec 3, 2019 9:12:20 PM`
GmtCreate.description_zh: 创建工作空间时间，示例格式`Dec 3, 2019 9:12:20 PM`

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the workspace was last modified. Example: `Dec 3, 2019 9:12:20 PM`
GmtModified.description_zh: 修改工作空间的时间，示例格式为`Dec 3, 2019 9:12:20 PM`

IsAllowDownload.description_en:
Indicates whether you are allowed to download the query result from DataStudio. Valid values:

1: You are allowed to download the query result from DataStudio.
0: You are not allowed to download the query result from DataStudio
IsAllowDownload.description_zh:
是否允许下载ide上查询的结果，取值如下：
1：允许下载。
0：不允许下载

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the workspace is a default workspace. Valid values:

1: The workspace is a default workspace.
0: The workspace is not a default workspace
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为默认工作空间，取值如下：
1：是。
0：否

ProjectDescription.description_zh: 工作空间的详细描述信息

ProjectMode.description_en:
The mode of the workspace. Valid values:

2: The workspace is in basic mode.
3: The workspace is in standard mode
ProjectMode.description_zh:
工作空间的模式，取值如下：
2：表示简单工作空间模式。
3：表示标准工作空间模式

ProjectName.description_en: The display name of the workspace

ProjectOwnerBaseId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the workspace owner
ProjectOwnerBaseId.description_zh: 工作空间所有者的阿里云ID

ProtectedMode.description_en:
Indicates whether the workspace protection feature is enabled. Valid values:

1: enabled
0: disabled
ProtectedMode.description_zh:
工作空间是否开启了保护模式，取值如下：
1：开启保护模式。
0：未开启保护模式

ResidentArea.description_en:
The type of the workspace. Valid values:

private
swap
ResidentArea.description_zh:
工作空间的类型。
private：私有区
swap：交换区

SchedulerMaxRetryTimes.description_en: The default maximum number of automatic reruns that are allowed after an error occurs
SchedulerMaxRetryTimes.description_zh: 默认出错自动重跑的次数

SchedulerRetryInterval.description_en: The default interval between automatic reruns after an error occurs. Unit: milliseconds. The maximum interval is 30 minutes. You must pay attention to the conversion between units
SchedulerRetryInterval.description_zh: 默认出错自动重跑的时间间隔，单位为ms。取值最大为30分钟，注意单位转换

Status.description_en:
The status of the workspace. Valid values:

0: AVAILABLE, which indicates that the workspace runs as expected.
1: DELETED, which indicates that the workspace is deleted.
2: INITIALIZING, which indicates that the workspace is being initialized.
3: INIT_FAILED, which indicates that the workspace fails to be initialized.
4: FORBIDDEN, which indicates that the workspace is manually disabled.
5: DELETING, which indicates that the workspace is being deleted.
6: DEL_FAILED, which indicates that the workspace fails to be deleted.
7: FROZEN, which indicates that the workspace is frozen due to overdue payments.
8: UPDATING, which indicates that the workspace is being updated. The workspace enters this state after you associate a new compute engine with the workspace and the compute engine is initialized.
9: UPDATE_FAILED, which indicates that the workspace fails to be updated
Status.description_zh:
工作空间的状态，取值如下：
0：AVAILABLE，工作空间运行正常。
1：DELETED，工作空间已被删除。
2：INITIALIZING，初始化工作空间。
3：INIT_FAILED，工作空间初始化失败。
4：FORBIDDEN，手动禁用工作空间。
5：DELETING，正在删除工作空间。
6：DEL_FAILED，工作空间删除失败。
7：FROZEN，工作空间欠费冻结。
8：UPDATING，更新工作空间（为工作空间添加并初始化计算引擎）。
9：UPDATE_FAILED，更新工作空间（为工作空间添加并初始化计算引擎）失败

TablePrivacyMode.description_en:
Indicates whether the MaxCompute tables in the workspace are visible to the users within a tenant. Valid values:

0: invisible
1: visible
TablePrivacyMode.description_zh:
MaxCompute表的可见性权限，取值如下：
0：租户内用户不可见MaxCompute表。
1：租户内用户可见MaxCompute表

Tags.description_en: The tags added to the workspace
Tags.description_zh: 工作空间绑定的标签信息列表

UseProxyOdpsAccount.description_en: Indicates whether a proxy account is used to access the MaxCompute compute engine associated with the workspace
UseProxyOdpsAccount.description_zh: 访问MaxCompute引擎是否使用代理账号

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，取值如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
